verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents some user control over data lifecycle. The official CLI exposes `destroy instance`, the CLI walkthrough ends with a clean-up step, and users manage persistent volumes from the Storage page, choosing whether data outlives an instance. There is no documented data-retention policy, no deletion guarantees (such as host-side disk wiping on the marketplace), no account or data erasure controls, and no configurable retention windows. missing for 10: explicit data retention policy, verified secure deletion/wipe of host disks, account-level data deletion controls, configurable retention periods, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: `vastai --help` prints the full command surface including search offers, create instance, and destroy instance.
